title: rate_cacher Module
content_markdown: The _rate_cacher_ module provides a means of caching and real-time querying of the ratesheets assigned to your clients and / or vendors. It also allows for real-time cost-based routing and cost-based filtering.
overview: The _rate_cacher_ module provides a means of caching and real-time querying of the ratesheets assigned to your clients and / or vendors. It also allows for real-time cost-based routing and cost-based filtering.

exported_functions.name: get_client_price

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The pseudo-var will hold the client_id originating this call

parameters.name: is_wholesale
parameters.description: The pseudo-var will contain either a 1 or a 0, depending on whether the call is wholesale or retail ( see client ratesheet provisioning )

parameters.name: dialled_no
parameters.description: The pseudo-var contains the DNIS - the dialled number for the current call. It needs to be in E164 format, without the leading +

parameters.name: prefix_pvar
parameters.description: The pseudo-var will contain the matched prefix from the client's ratesheet

parameters.name: destination_pvar
parameters.description: The pseudo-var will contain the matched destination from the client's ratesheet

parameters.name: price_pvar
parameters.description: The pseudo-var will contain the matched price from the client's ratesheet

parameters.name: minimum_pvar
parameters.description: The pseudo-var will contain the matched minimum from the client's ratesheet

parameters.name: increment_pvar
parameters.description: The pseudo-var will contain the matched increment from the client's ratesheet

exported_functions.description: For a call originating from the provided Client ID, on a wholesale or retail quality, going to dialled_no, the function will matched the dialled number against the client's ratesheet and return the matched prefix, destination, price, minimum and increment.

exported_functions.name: cost_based_filtering

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The pseudo-var will hold the client_id originating this call

parameters.name: is_wholesale
parameters.description: The pseudo-var will contain either a 1 or a 0, depending on whether the call is wholesale or retail ( see client ratesheet provisioning )

parameters.name: vendors_csv
parameters.description: The pseudo-var contains a list of Vendors that need to be filtered based on the desired margin ( keep just those that match your desired percentage margin for this call )

parameters.name: dialled_no
parameters.description: The pseudo-var contains the DNIS - the dialled number for the current call. It needs to be in E164 format, without the leading +

parameters.name: desired_margin
parameters.description: The pseudo-var contains the minimum Integer margin that the script writer wants to achieve, based on the Client sell and Vendor buy prices. The formula used is : vendor_margin=(client_price - results[i])*100/client_price) . If the vendor_margin is higher than the desired_margin, then the Vendor is ok to use. The desired margin can be positive ( call will be profitable ) or negative ( the call will cause a loss ).

parameters.name: out_vendor_csv
parameters.description: The pseudo-var is an output parameter, and the pvar will get populated with the CSV list of Vendors that meet the desired margin condition

exported_functions.description: For a call originating from the provided Client ID, on a wholesale or retail quality, going to dialled_no, the function removes the Vendors ( from the vendor_csv list ) which do not pass the desired_margin condition, and sets the out_vendor_csv variable to the list of Vendor that meet the margin condition, while maintaining the initial order provided in the vendor_csv variable.

exported_mi_functions.name: rate_cacher:addVendor

parameters.name: vendorName
parameters.description: name of the Vendor to be added

exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: rc_addVendor. Adds a new Vendor, without assigning any ratesheet to it.

examples.code:
## Add a new Vendor
# opensips-cli -x mi rate_cacher:addVendor myNewVendor

exported_mi_functions.name: rate_cacher:deleteVendor

parameters.name: vendorName
parameters.description: name of the Vendor to be deleted

exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: rc_deleteVendor. Removes a vendor from memory, along with the ratesheet asigned with it ( if any )

examples.code:
## Delete a Vendor
# opensipss-cli -x mi rate_cacher:deleteVendor myNewVendor

exported_mi_functions.name: rate_cacher:reloadVendorRate

parameters.name: vendorName
parameters.description: name of the Vendor

parameters.name: ratesheet_id
parameters.description: ID of the ratesheet to be reloaded and assigned

exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: rc_reloadVendorRate. Reloads the provided ratesheet and assigns it to the Vendor

examples.code:
## Reloads a Vendor Ratesheet
# opensips-cli -x mi rate_cacher:reloadVendorRate myVendor 3

exported_mi_functions.name: rate_cacher:deleteVendorRate

parameters.name: vendorName
parameters.description: name of the Vendor

exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: rc_deleteVendorRate. Deletes the assigned ratesheet from the Vendor

examples.code:
## Reloads a Vendor Ratesheet
# opensips-cli -x mi rate_cacher:deleteVendorRate myVendor

exported_mi_functions.name: rate_cacher:getVendorPrice

parameters.name: vendorName
parameters.description: name of the Vendor

parameters.name: dialledNumber
parameters.description: number to match in the above Vendor's ratesheet

exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: rc_getVendorPrice. Fetches all the ratesheet information ( destination name, price, minimum, increment ) for the provided Vendor and dialled number

examples.code:
## Query for the price of myVendor for the 4072731825 number
#/usr/local/bin/opensips-cli -x mi rate_cacher:getVendorPrice myVendor 4072731825
{
    "prefix": "40727",
    "destination": "ROMANIA MOBILE VODAFONE",
    "price": 0.05,
    "minimum": 1,
    "increment": 1,
    "currency": "USD"
}
examples.description: Query for the price of myVendor for the 4072731825 number

exported_mi_functions.name: rate_cacher:getClientPrice

parameters.name: ClientName
parameters.description: name of the Client

parameters.name: isWholesale
parameters.description: wholesale = 1, retail = 0

parameters.name: dialledNumber
parameters.description: number to match in the above Client's ratesheet

exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: rc_getClientPrice. Fetches all the ratesheet information ( destination name, price, minimum, increment ) for the provided Client, on the specified quality ( wholesale vs retail ) and dialled number

examples.code:
## Query for the price of myClient, on the retail quality, for the 4072731825 number
#/usr/local/bin/opensips-cli -x mi rate_cacher:getClientPrice myClient 0 4072731825
{
    "prefix": "40727",
    "destination": "ROMANIA MOBILE VODAFONE",
    "price": 0.03,
    "minimum": 1,
    "increment": 1,
    "currency": "USD"
}
examples.description: Query for the price of myClient, on the retail quality, for the 4072731825 number
